zh: 那个推销员直接挂了我的电话。
en: The salesman just {hung up on} me.

zh: 他刚出去一下，十分钟后回来。
en: He's just {stepped out|popped out|gone out|nipped out}. He'll be back in ten minutes.

zh: 我想让人把电话转接到财务部。
en: I'm trying to get {put through|transferred|connected} to the accounts team.

zh: 抱歉，你的声音断断续续的。
en: Sorry, you're {breaking up|cutting out}. Can you say that again?

zh: 把视图缩小一点，这样我们能看到整个图表。
en: Can you {zoom out} so we can see the whole chart?

zh: 请稍等一下，我找一下那个文件。
en: {Bear with} me a moment while I find the file.

zh: 我不知道老板一直在旁听我们的通话。
en: I didn't know my boss was {listening in|eavesdropping} on our call.

zh: 开会时人们陆陆续续地进来了。
en: People {trickled in|drifted in|came in} late to the meeting.

zh: 你能大声点吗？我听不清。
en: Can you {speak up|speak louder|talk louder}? I can't hear you.

zh: 我能插一句吗？
en: Can I just {jump in|come in|cut in|chip in} here?

zh: 我们进入下一个议题吧。
en: Let's {move on|go on} to the next item.

zh: 你能把幻灯片调到大屏幕上吗？
en: Can you {bring up|pull up|put up|open|show} the slides on the big screen?

zh: 我在开车，十分钟后再打回来。
en: I'm driving. I'll {call back|ring back|phone back} in ten minutes.

zh: 周会已经推迟到周四了。
en: The weekly meeting has been {pushed back|put back|moved|postponed|delayed} to Thursday.

zh: 有想法的话随时插话。
en: Feel free to {chip in|jump in|speak up|join in} if you have any ideas.

zh: 那个会拖了三个小时。
en: The meeting {dragged on|went on} for three hours.

zh: 你能把她的电话号码记下来吗？
en: Can you {note down|write down|jot down|take down} her phone number?

zh: 昨天的会超时了二十分钟。
en: Yesterday's meeting {ran over|overran|went over|ran on} by twenty minutes.

zh: 请稍等一下，我查一查。
en: Can you {hold on|hang on|hold} a moment while I check?

zh: 电话打到一半就断线了。
en: We got {cut off|disconnected} in the middle of the call.

zh: 我还没解释完她就挂了电话。
en: She {hung up} before I could explain.

zh: 时间不多了，我们按议程来吧。
en: We're short on time, so let's {stick to|keep to|follow} the agenda.

zh: 开会时我完全走神了。
en: I completely {spaced out|zoned out|switched off|drifted off} during the meeting.
